newsitem.title: USA: Trans World sets fall U.S. air fare sale.
newsitem.headline: Trans World sets fall U.S. air fare sale.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said it launched an air fare sale, effective today, throughout its North American route system.
Roundtrip fares range from $208 to $358, based on distance flown.

All fares are non-refundable and are valid for travel between August 19 and December 16, TWA said. Tickets must be purchased at least 14 days in advance and by midnight the day after reservations are made, but no later than August 8.
In most cases, a Saturday night stay is required. Other restrictions apply.

Off-peak round-trip fares include $208 for trips under 500 miles, such as St. Louis-Milwaukee; $248 for 500 to 999 miles, such as New York-St. Louis; $268 for 1,000 to 1,499 miles, such as Atlanta-Denver; $308 for 1,500 to 1,999 miles such as San Diego-St. Louis; $338 for 2,000 to 2,499 miles such as Seattle-Boston, and $358 for 2,500 to 2,999 miles, such as New York-San Francisco.
